rationale: The digest shows checkoutservice memory spiked by 1876% (z=375.25) and CPU by 4411% (z=219.84), directly causing a 764% latency increase. All other services in the trace remain within normal baselines, isolating the fault to checkoutservice.

proposed_fix.description: Restart checkoutservice pods to clear the memory leak and restore performance, then audit application code for unbounded caches or resource leaks.
